summary.text: John Ellison is a Republican member of the Nevada Senate, representing District 19, which covers Lincoln and White Pine counties and parts of Clark, Elko, Eureka and Nye counties. He has served in the Senate since 2024, after serving in the Nevada Assembly from 2010 to 2022.

paragraphs.text: The Nevada Legislature says Ellison was born in Elko, Nevada, in 1953 and lists his occupation as electrical contractor.
His page lists his Assembly leadership roles as Speaker pro Tempore in 2015-2016, Minority Whip Rural in 2017, and Co-Deputy Minority Floor Leader (North) in 2019.
He was first elected to the Senate in November 2024 and is a member of the Senate Public Safety and Security Committee.
